headline: Crypto Caution: RBI Wary of Cryptocurrency, Will Promote Blockchain-Like Technologies, Says Governor - dainiktribuneonline.com
summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said on Saturday that India has adopted a cautious stance toward cryptocurrencies. He said the central bank will promote blockchain-like technologies instead.
why: The Reserve Bank of India sets policy on digital assets and payments in India, shaping how crypto businesses can operate in the market.
